item.title: Iranian operatives used AI to impersonate Americans
item.description: Meta removed accounts linked to an Iran-based operation using AI to target U.S. audiences with posts about American politics.

item.title: Tech leaders warn of urgent need to address AI risks
item.description: OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft and over 100 other companies cautioned on Thursday that organizations have only months to prepare for potential AI threats.

item.title: Trump orders renaming of Lake Ontario to 'Lake America'
item.description: President Trump signed an executive order on Thursday to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America,' following through on a prior commitment.

item.title: Will Kevin Warsh Squander a Major Opportunity?
item.description: The new Fed chair will be in the spotlight at the central bank's prominent Jackson Hole conference. He should make the most of it.
